summary: Two listed churches. Weekend and weekday Mass times and Saturday confessions are the same in every issue read, and the Friday afternoon Adoration takes its 1:30 PM start from the parish's events page. Bistrica Masses are dated (Nov 3, Nov 17, Dec 1, Dec 8). Open: whether to keep the Friday 8:15 AM Mass 'when school is in session'. Left out: eve-of-first-Friday and eve-of-holy-day confessions (cannot be written as weekly), weddings and the Nov 21 family event.
